keyPoints: Badi sankhyaon ko padhne ke liye Indian system me har do ank ke baad comma lagta hai: 1,00,000 ek lakh aur 1,00,00,000 ek crore hota hai.
International system me teen-teen ankon par comma lagta hai: 1,000,000 ek million hota hai, aur 10 lakh = 1 million.
Sankhyaon ki tulna ke liye pehle ankon ki ginti dekho — zyada ank wali sankhya hamesha badi hoti hai, jaise 98,765 > 9,876.
Ank barabar hon to bayen se pehla alag ank dekho — 5,43,216 aur 5,34,216 me teesra ank faisla karta hai.
Sankhya ko vistarit roop me likhna use samajhne me madad karta hai: 5,43,216 = 5 lakh + 4 das-hazaar + 3 hazaar + 2 sau + 1 das + 6.
Place value ka matlab hai ank ki sthiti ke hisaab se uska maan — 7,07,707 me teenon 7 alag-alag maan rakhte hain.
Aam galti: Indian aur International comma ko milana — 10,00,000 ko ten lakh padho; one million likhne me 1,000,000 hota hai.
